about: Painted tech-tree icons for every ResearchDef (Higgsfield gpt_image_2_5, medium, transparent), shipped as public/art/research/<id>.webp (128px WebP). Text-to-image with the resource-icon sheet as style reference (same look as items/resources).
prompt: Game tech-tree icon: {subject}. Match the rendering style of the reference icons exactly (stylized 3D game icon, chunky shapes, soft warm lighting, bright saturated cozy colors, subtle rim light), but draw ONLY the new subject, none of the reference objects. Three-quarter view, centered, filling the frame, isolated on a transparent background. No text, no frame, no ground shadow.
postprocess: remove border-connected background haze (flood fill below max border alpha + 24), trim to alpha bounds, pad square 4%, resize 128px LANCZOS, WebP q82
